en.t: Roman emperor Trajan dedicates a column celebrating and depicting his victory over the Dacians
en.s: Trajan's Column (Italian: Colonna Traiana, Latin: Columna Traiani) is a Roman triumphal column in Rome, Italy, that commemorates Roman emperor Trajan's victory in the Dacian Wars. It was probably constructed under the supervision of the architect Apollodorus of Damascus at the order of the Roman Senate. It is located in Trajan's Forum, north of the Roman Forum.

zh.t: 罗马皇帝图拉真为纪念战胜达契亚人而为纪功柱举行落成仪式
zh.s: 图拉真纪功柱位于意大利罗马，是一座纪念罗马皇帝图拉真战胜达契亚人的凯旋柱。它可能由建筑师大马士革的阿波罗多罗斯主持建造，工程由罗马元老院下令。纪功柱位于图拉真广场，在古罗马广场以北。

en.t: Zhu Wen forces Emperor Ai into abdicating, ending the Tang dynasty after nearly three hundred years of rule
en.s: Emperor Ai of Tang (27 October 892 – 26 March 908), also known as Emperor Zhaoxuan of Tang (唐昭宣帝), born Li Zuo, later known as Li Zhu or Li Chu (Chinese: 李柷; pinyin: Lǐ Chù), was the last emperor of the Tang dynasty of China. He reigned—as a puppet ruler—from 904 to 907. Emperor Ai was the son of Emperor Zhaozong. He was murdered by Zhu Wen.

zh.t: 朱温迫使唐哀帝退位，唐朝近三百年的统治终结
zh.s: 唐哀帝（892 年 10 月 27 日—908 年 3 月 26 日），又称唐昭宣帝，本名李祚，后来改名李柷，是唐朝末代皇帝。他自 904 年至 907 年在位，期间只是傀儡君主。他是唐昭宗之子，后来被朱温杀害。

en.s: The Battle of Mailberg took place on 12 May 1082. The opponents were Vratislaus II of Bohemia (Czech: Vratislav II.) and Leopold II, Margrave of Austria (German: Luitpold II).

zh.s: 迈尔贝格战役发生于1082年5月12日。交战双方是波希米亚的弗拉季斯拉夫二世（捷克语：Vratislav II.）和奥地利藩侯利奥波德二世（德语：Luitpold II）。

en.t: A church council presided over by Byzantine emperor Manuel I Komnenos in the Palace of Blachernae investigates the orthodoxy of the patriarch of Antioch, Soterichos Panteugenos
en.s: Manuel I Komnenos (Greek: Μανουήλ Κομνηνός, romanized: Manouḗl Komnēnós; 28 November 1118 – 24 September 1180) was a Byzantine emperor of the 12th century who reigned over a crucial turning point in the history of Byzantium and the Mediterranean. His reign saw the last flowering of the Komnenian restoration, during which the Byzantine Empire experienced a resurgence of military and economic power and enjoyed a cultural revival.

zh.t: 曼努埃尔一世在布拉赫奈宫主持教会会议，审查安条克牧首索泰里科斯·潘泰乌根诺斯的正统信仰
zh.s: 曼努埃尔一世·科穆宁（希腊语：Μανουήλ Κομνηνός，转写：Manouḗl Komnēnós；1118年11月28日—1180年9月24日）是12世纪的拜占庭皇帝，其统治时期是拜占庭和地中海历史的重要转折阶段。在他执政期间，科穆宁王朝复兴达到最后的繁盛，拜占庭帝国军事和经济实力回升，文化也得到复兴。

en.t: Richard I of England marries Berengaria of Navarre in Cyprus; she is crowned Queen consort of England the same day
en.s: Berengaria of Navarre (Basque: Berengela, Spanish: Berenguela, French: Bérengère; c. 1165–1170 – 23 December 1230) was Queen of England as the wife of Richard I of England. She was the eldest daughter of Sancho VI of Navarre and Sancha of Castile. As is the case with many of the medieval English queens, little is known of her life.

zh.t: 英格兰国王理查一世与纳瓦拉的贝伦加丽亚在塞浦路斯成婚；她同日加冕为英格兰王后
zh.s: 纳瓦拉的贝伦加丽亚（巴斯克语：Berengela；西班牙语：Berenguela；法语：Bérengère；约生于 1165 至 1170 年间，卒于 1230 年 12 月 23 日）是英格兰王后，也是理查一世的妻子。她是纳瓦拉国王桑乔六世与卡斯蒂利亚的桑查的长女。与许多中世纪英格兰王后一样，她的生平鲜为人知。

en.s: The Battle of Kumegawa (久米川の戦い Kumegawa no tatakai) was part of the decisive Kōzuke-Musashi Campaign during the Genkō War in Japan that ultimately ended the Kamakura Shogunate. Fought in present-day Higashimurayama, Tokyo at the foot of the Hachikokuyama ridge on May 12, 1333, it pitted the anti-shogunate imperial forces led by Nitta Yoshisada against the forces of the pro-Shogunate Hōjō Regency led by Sakurada Sadakuni. The battle was an immediate follow on from the previous day's nearby Battle of Kotesashi.

zh.s: 久米川之战（日语：久米川の戦い，罗马字：Kumegawa no tatakai）是元弘之乱期间上野—武藏战役的一部分。这场战役最终导致镰仓幕府灭亡。1333年5月12日，讨幕派天皇军在新田义贞率领下，与拥护幕府的北条执权方军队交战，后者由樱田贞国指挥。战斗地点在今东京都东村山市八国山山脊脚下，紧接在前一天附近发生的小手指原之战之后。

en.t: Jagiellonian University, the oldest university in Poland, is founded in Kraków
en.s: The Jagiellonian University (/ˌjɑːɡjəˈləʊ.ni.ən/; Polish: Uniwersytet Jagielloński, UJ) is a public research university in Kraków, Poland. Founded in 1364 by King Casimir III the Great, it is the oldest university in Poland and one of the oldest universities in continuous operation in the world. The university grounds form part of the Kraków Old Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

zh.t: 波兰最古老的雅盖隆大学在克拉科夫成立
zh.s: 雅盖隆大学是一所位于波兰克拉科夫的公立研究型大学。该校由卡齐米日三世于1364年创办，是波兰最古老的大学，也是世界上持续办学时间最长的大学之一。校园属于克拉科夫老城的一部分，该城区被列为联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

en.s: The Prince of Anhua rebellion or Prince Anhua uprising was a rebellion by Zhu Zhifan, the Prince of Anhua and member of the Zhu royal family, against the reign of the Zhengde Emperor from 12 May 1510 to 30 May 1510. The Prince of Anhua revolt was one of two princedom rebellions during Zhengde's rule as emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and precedes the Prince of Ning Rebellion in 1519.

zh.s: 安化王之乱，又称安化王起义，是安化王、朱氏宗室成员朱寘鐇于1510年5月12日至30日发动的一场反抗明武宗统治的叛乱。这是明武宗在位期间两场藩王叛乱之一，之后于1519年又发生了宁王之乱。

en.t: National University of San Marcos, the oldest university in the Americas, is founded in Lima, Peru
en.s: The National University of San Marcos (Spanish: Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos, UNMSM) is a public research university located in Lima, the capital of Peru. In the Americas, it is the first officially established (privilege by Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor) and the oldest continuously operating university. The university started in the general studies that were offered in the convent of the Rosario of the order of Santo Domingo—the current Basilica and Convent of Santo Domingo—on July 1, 1548.

zh.t: 圣马科斯国立大学在秘鲁利马创立
zh.s: 圣马科斯国立大学（西班牙语：Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos，简称 UNMSM）是秘鲁首都利马的一所公立研究型大学。经神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理五世授予特许后，该校成为美洲最早正式设立、也是持续办学时间最长的大学。该校最初在圣多明各修道院的玫瑰圣母通识课程中开展教学；该修道院现为圣多明各圣殿及修道院，课程于 1548 年 7 月 1 日开办。

en.s: The Capture of Santiago de Cuba was a minor military event that took place towards the end of the Anglo–Spanish War in May 1603. Santiago de Cuba was attacked and sacked by English privateers led by Christopher Cleeve.

zh.s: 1603年，英西战争接近尾声时，英国私掠船船长克里斯托弗·克利夫率队袭击并洗劫了古巴圣地亚哥。这是一场规模较小的军事行动。

en.s: The siege of Oreshek (1611–1612) was the Swedish capture of the fortress of Oreshek after an eight-month siege during the Ingrian War of 1610–1617.

en.s: The Battle of Focchies was a significant naval engagement that took place on 12 May 1649, in the harbour of Focchies, Smyrna between a Venetian fleet of nineteen warships under the command of Giacomo da Riva, and an Ottoman fleet of eleven warships, ten galleasses, and seventy-two galleys, with the battle resulting in a crushing victory for the Venetian fleet.

zh.s: 福克希斯海战是1649年5月12日在士麦那福克希斯港发生的一场重要海战。交战双方是贾科莫·达·里瓦指挥的19艘威尼斯战舰，以及11艘奥斯曼战舰、10艘大型帆桨船和72艘桨帆船。威尼斯舰队取得压倒性胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Kopychyntsi (Ukrainian: Битва під Копичинцями, Polish: Bitwa pod Kopyczyńcami; 12 May 1651) was fought between the Cossack Hetmanate and Crimean Khanate against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth as a part of the Khmelnytsky Uprising. Near the site of the present-day city of Kopychyntsi in Ukraine, a forces of the Zaporozhian Cossacks under the command of Osavul Demko Lyzovets, Colonels Fylon Dzhalaliy and Semen Savych was defeated by the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth's forces under the command of Hetman Marcin Kalinowski, Noblemans Marek Sobieski and Aleksander Koniecpolski.

zh.s: 科皮钦齐战役（乌克兰语：Битва під Копичинцями；波兰语：Bitwa pod Kopyczyńcami；1651年5月12日）是赫梅利尼茨基起义期间的一场战斗，交战双方是哥萨克酋长国和克里米亚汗国联军，以及波兰立陶宛联邦军队。战斗发生在今乌克兰科皮钦齐附近。扎波罗热哥萨克军队由德姆科·雷佐韦茨奥萨乌尔、菲隆·贾拉利和谢苗·萨维奇上校指挥，败于马尔钦·卡利诺夫斯基大将、贵族马雷克·索别斯基和亚历山大·科涅茨波尔斯基指挥的波兰立陶宛联邦军队。

en.s: The siege of Galway took place from August 1651 to 12 May 1652 during the Cromwellian conquest of Ireland. Galway was the last city held by Irish Catholic forces in Ireland and its fall signalled the end to most organised resistance to the Parliamentarian conquest of the country. The English Parliamentarians were commanded by Charles Coote, an English settler who had commanded Parliamentarian forces in the northwest of Ireland throughout the Irish Confederate Wars.

zh.s: 戈尔韦围城战于1651年8月至1652年5月12日发生在克伦威尔征服爱尔兰期间。戈尔韦是爱尔兰境内最后一座由爱尔兰天主教军队控制的城市；它的陷落标志着议会派征服爱尔兰的有组织抵抗基本结束。英格兰议会派由查尔斯·库特指挥。他是一名英格兰移民，在爱尔兰邦联战争期间曾指挥西北部的议会派部队。

en.s: The Battle of Tilpat was fought between Jats and Mughal Subahdars on 12 May 1669. Gokula Jat burnt the city of Saidabad near Mathura which caused Mughal commander Abdul Nabi Khan to attack the village of Sūra. Abdul Nabi was wounded and killed. Aurangzeb sent Hassan Ali Khan to fight the rebels. Gokula Jat was captured alive during the battle and immediately sent to Delhi.

zh.s: 1669年5月12日，贾特人和莫卧儿苏巴达尔军队在蒂尔帕特交战。戈库拉·贾特焚烧了马图拉附近的赛达巴德城，莫卧儿指挥官阿卜杜勒·纳比汗因此袭击苏拉村。阿卜杜勒·纳比受伤后身亡。奥朗则布派哈桑·阿里汗镇压起义者。战斗中，戈库拉·贾特被活捉，并立即被送往德里。

en.s: The Battle of Chappar Chiri, also called Battle of Sirhind, was fought between Mughal Empire and the Sikhs on 12 May 1710 at Chappar Chiri, located 20 kilometers from Sirhind.

zh.s: 查帕尔奇里战役又称锡尔欣德战役，于1710年5月12日在查帕尔奇里发生，地点距锡尔欣德20公里。交战双方是莫卧儿帝国和锡克人。

en.t: Maria Theresa of Austria is crowned Queen of Bohemia after defeating her rival, Charles VII, Holy Roman Emperor
en.s: Maria Theresa (Maria Theresia Walburga Amalia Christina; 13 May 1717 – 29 November 1780) was the ruler of the Habsburg monarchy from 1740 until her death in 1780, and the only woman to hold the position in her own right. She was the sovereign of Austria, Hungary, Croatia, Bohemia, Transylvania, Slavonia, Mantua, Milan, Moravia, Galicia and Lodomeria, Dalmatia, Austrian Netherlands, Carinthia, Carniola, Gorizia and Gradisca, Austrian Silesia, Tyrol, Styria, and Parma.

zh.t: 奥地利的玛丽亚·特蕾西亚击败对手查理七世后加冕为波希米亚女王
zh.s: 玛丽亚·特蕾西亚（Maria Theresia Walburga Amalia Christina；1717年5月13日—1780年11月29日）自1740年起统治哈布斯堡君主国，直至1780年去世。她是唯一以自身权利统治该国的女性。她统治的领地包括奥地利、匈牙利、克罗地亚、波希米亚、特兰西瓦尼亚、斯拉沃尼亚、曼图亚、米兰、摩拉维亚、加利西亚和洛多梅里亚、达尔马提亚、奥属尼德兰、克恩顿、克雷恩、戈里齐亚和格拉迪斯卡、奥属西里西亚、蒂罗尔、施蒂利亚及帕尔马。

en.t: Heinrich XI, count of the Principality of Reuss-Greiz, is elevated to Prince by Joseph II, Holy Roman Emperor
en.s: The Principality of Reuss-Greiz (German: Fürstentum Reuß-Greiz), officially called the Principality of Reuss Elder Line (German: Fürstentum Reuß älterer Linie) after 1848, was a state in the German Empire, ruled by members of the House of Reuss. The Counts Reuss of Greiz, Lower-Greiz and Upper-Greiz (German: Reuß zu Greiz, Untergreiz und Obergreiz) were elevated to princely status in 1778 and thereafter bore the title of Prince Reuss, Elder Line, or Prince Reuss of Greiz.

zh.t: 罗伊斯-格赖茨公国伯爵海因里希十一世获神圣罗马帝国皇帝约瑟夫二世册封为亲王
zh.s: 罗伊斯-格赖茨公国是德意志帝国境内的一个邦，由罗伊斯家族成员统治。1848年后，该邦正式称为罗伊斯长系公国。罗伊斯-格赖茨、下格赖茨和上格赖茨伯爵于1778年获封亲王，此后使用罗伊斯长系亲王或格赖茨亲王的称号。

loc: 美国南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿

en.s: The siege of Charleston was a major engagement and major British victory in the American Revolutionary War, fought in the environs of Charles Town (today Charleston), between March 29 and May 12, 1780. The British, following the collapse of their northern strategy in late 1777 and their withdrawal from Philadelphia in 1778, shifted their focus to the North American Southern Colonies.

zh.s: 查尔斯顿围城战是美国独立战争中的一场重要战役，也是英军的一场重大胜利。战斗于1780年3月29日至5月12日在查尔斯镇（今查尔斯顿）周边展开。1777年末，英国北方战略崩溃，英军于1778年撤离费城，此后将注意力转向北美南部殖民地。

en.s: The Action of 12 May 1796 was a minor naval engagement during the French Revolutionary Wars between a squadron of British Royal Navy frigates and a frigate and four smaller ships of the Navy of the Batavian Republic. The British squadron had been detached on the previous day from the British North Sea fleet under Admiral Adam Duncan, which was cruising off the Batavian fleet anchorage at the Texel, while the Batavian squadron was returning to the Netherlands from the Norwegian coast where it had been sheltering since suffering defeat at the Action of 22 August 1795 the previous year.

zh.s: 1796年5月12日海战是法国大革命战争期间的一场小规模海战，交战双方是英国皇家海军一支护卫舰分舰队，以及巴达维亚共和国海军的一艘护卫舰和四艘小型舰艇。英国分舰队前一天从亚当·邓肯海军上将指挥的北海舰队中分出，当时北海舰队正在巴达维亚舰队的特塞尔锚地附近巡航。巴达维亚分舰队正从挪威海岸返回荷兰；此前它自上一年在1795年8月22日海战中战败后一直躲避在挪威海岸。

en.t: Fall of the Republic of Venice
en.s: The Republic of Venice was dissolved and dismembered by the French general Napoleon Bonaparte and the Habsburg monarchy on 12 May 1797, ending approximately 1,100 years of its existence. It was the final action of Napoleon's Italian campaign of 1796–1797 before the War of the First Coalition formally ended in October. In 1796, General Napoleon had been sent by the newly formed French Republic to confront Austria, as part of the Italian front of the French Revolutionary Wars.

zh.s: 1797年5月12日，威尼斯共和国被法国将军拿破仑·波拿巴和哈布斯堡王朝解散并瓜分，结束了约1,100年的历史。这是拿破仑1796—1797年意大利战役的最后一项行动；第一次反法同盟战争直到同年10月才正式结束。1796年，新成立的法兰西共和国派拿破仑前往意大利战场与奥地利交战。

en.s: The Battle of Bassignana (12 May 1799) saw an Imperial Russian army led by Andrei Grigorevich Rosenberg attempt to establish a bridgehead on the south bank of the Po River in the presence of a Republican French army under Jean Victor Marie Moreau. The French rapidly massed superior strength and forced the Russians to abandon their foothold with serious losses. This War of the Second Coalition action occurred near the town of Bassignana, located in the angle between the Po and Tanaro Rivers, about 19 kilometres (12 mi) northeast of Alessandria, Italy.

zh.s: 1799年5月12日的巴西尼亚纳战役中，安德烈·格里戈里耶维奇·罗森贝格率领的俄罗斯帝国军试图在法军让-维克多·马里·莫罗指挥下，于波河南岸建立桥头堡。法军迅速集中优势兵力，迫使俄军付出重大伤亡后放弃阵地。这场第二次反法同盟战争中的战斗发生在意大利巴西尼亚纳附近，该镇位于波河与塔纳罗河交汇处形成的夹角内，距亚历山德里亚东北约19公里（12英里）。

en.s: The Capture of Tranquebar (Danish: Overtagelsen af Trankebar) or the Surrender of Tranquebar (Danish: Overgivelsen af Trankebar) was a British takeover of the capital of Danish India, Tranquebar. The capture was quick and successful, with the Dano-Norwegian governor, Peter Anker, surrendering with the arrival of the British.

zh.s: 特兰奎巴尔陷落又称特兰奎巴尔投降，是英国接管丹麦属印度首府特兰奎巴尔的行动。英军抵达后，丹麦—挪威总督彼得·安克尔很快投降，接管行动顺利完成。

en.s: The Battle of Kuopio was fought between Swedish and Russian forces at Kuopio in Northern Savonia on 12 May 1808 during the Finnish War.

zh.s: 1808年5月12日，瑞典和俄罗斯军队在芬兰战争期间于北萨沃尼亚的库奥皮奥交战。

en.s: The Second Battle of Porto, also known as the Battle of the Douro, was a battle in which General Arthur Wellesley's Anglo-Portuguese Army defeated Marshal Nicolas Soult's French troops on 12 May 1809 and took back the city of Porto. After taking command of the British troops in Portugal on 22 April, Wellesley (later named 1st Duke of Wellington) immediately advanced on Porto and made a surprise crossing of the Douro River, approaching Porto where its defences were weak. Soult's late attempts to muster a defence were in vain. The French quickly abandoned the city in a disorderly retreat.

zh.s: 第二次波尔图战役又称杜罗河战役。1809年5月12日，阿瑟·韦尔斯利将军率领的英葡联军击败尼古拉·苏尔特元帅的法军，收复波尔图。韦尔斯利于4月22日接掌驻葡萄牙英军后，立即向波尔图推进，并出其不意地渡过杜罗河，从防守薄弱处接近波尔图。苏尔特仓促组织防御，但未能奏效，法军很快撤离城市，退却时阵形混乱。

en.s: The second siege of Badajoz (22 April – 12 May and 18 May – 10 June, 1811) saw an Anglo-Portuguese Army, first led by William Carr Beresford and later commanded by Arthur Wellesley, the Viscount Wellington, besiege a French garrison under Armand Philippon at Badajoz, Spain. After failing to force a surrender, Wellington withdrew his army when the French mounted a successful relief effort by combining the armies of Marshals Nicolas Soult and Auguste Marmont.

zh.t: 巴达霍斯第二次围城战（1811年）
zh.s: 巴达霍斯第二次围城战分为1811年4月22日至5月12日，以及5月18日至6月10日两段。威廉·卡尔·贝雷斯福德起初率领英葡联军，后来由阿瑟·韦尔斯利子爵、即后来的威灵顿公爵接掌，围攻西班牙巴达霍斯由阿尔芒·菲利蓬率领的法军驻军。韦尔斯利未能迫使对方投降；法国元帅尼古拉·苏尔特和奥古斯特·马尔蒙合兵成功解围后，他撤出了部队。

en.s: The Battle of Ramales, a battle of the First Carlist War, occurred at Ramales in Cantabria on May 12, 1839. The Liberals were commanded by Baldomero Espartero, the Carlists by Rafael Maroto. The Liberals, initially outnumbering the Carlists twice over, ended up having four times as many forces. This resulted from the fact that Maroto kept eight of his seventeen battalions in reserve and had ordered the defenders of the fortification of Guardamino to abandon this post. Maroto was later accused of complicity with his opponent Espartero for having performed these two actions.

zh.s: 第一次卡洛斯战争中的拉马莱斯战役于1839年5月12日在坎塔布里亚的拉马莱斯发生。自由派军队由巴尔多梅罗·埃斯帕特罗指挥，卡洛斯派由拉斐尔·马罗托指挥。自由派起初人数是卡洛斯派的两倍，最后兵力达到对方的四倍。这是因为马罗托把17个营中的8个留作预备队，并命令守卫瓜尔达米诺要塞的部队放弃阵地。马罗托后来被指控与对手埃斯帕特罗串通，故意采取了这两项行动。

en.s: Independence is a city mostly in, and one of two county seats of, Jackson County, Missouri, United States. It is a satellite city of Kansas City, Missouri, and is the largest suburb on the Missouri side of the Kansas City metropolitan area. In 2020, it had a total population of 123,011, making it the fifth-most populous city in Missouri. A small part of the city extends into Clay County.
en.n: The Donner Party of pioneers departs Independence, Missouri for California, on what will become a year-long journey of hardship and cannibalism.

zh.s: 独立城位于美国密苏里州杰克逊县，市区大部分在该县境内，也是该县的两个县治之一。它是密苏里州堪萨斯城的卫星城，也是堪萨斯城都会区密苏里州一侧最大的郊区。2020年人口为123,011人，是密苏里州人口第五多的城市。该市有一小部分延伸至克莱县。
zh.n: 唐纳拓荒队从密苏里州独立城启程前往加利福尼亚，踏上一段后来长达一年的艰难旅程，途中发生了食人事件。

en.s: The Battle of Little Robe Creek, also called the Battle of Antelope Hills, took place on May 12, 1858. It actually was a series of three distinct encounters that took place on a single day, between the Comanches on the one side, and Texas Rangers, militia, and allied Tonkawas attacking them. It was undertaken against the laws of the United States at the time, which strictly forbade such an incursion into the Indian Territories of Oklahoma, and marked a significant escalation of the Indian Wars.

zh.s: 小袍溪之战又称羚羊丘之战，发生于1858年5月12日。当天实际发生了三场相互独立的交战，参战一方是科曼奇人，另一方是进攻他们的得克萨斯骑警、民兵及其盟军通卡瓦人。美国当时的法律严格禁止此类行动进入俄克拉荷马的印第安领地，这场战斗仍然发生，并使印第安战争明显升级。

en.s: The First Battle of Pyramid Lake in 1860 was one of the opening conflicts of the Paiute War in Nevada between the American people and the Paiute people, who had resisted the increasing numbers of migrants who traveled the California Trail through their territory, taking scarce game and water resources, as well as altercations with the Pony Express.

zh.s: 1860年的金字塔湖第一次战役是派尤特战争初期的一场冲突，发生在内华达州。美国移民人数不断增加，他们沿加利福尼亚小道穿过派尤特人的领地，猎取当地稀缺的猎物和水源；派尤特人还与小马快递发生过冲突。

en.s: The Battle of Raymond was fought on May 12, 1863, near Raymond, Mississippi, during the Vicksburg Campaign of the American Civil War. The bitter fight pitted elements of Union Army Maj. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's Army of the Tennessee against Confederate forces of Lt. Gen. John C. Pemberton's Department of the Mississippi and East Louisiana. The Confederates failed to prevent the Federal troops from reaching the Southern Railroad and isolating Vicksburg, Mississippi, from reinforcement and resupply. During the morning of the 12th, the Confederates enjoyed a two-to-one advantage in numbers, as they faced off across Fourteen Mile Creek against a single Federal brigade.

zh.s: 雷蒙德战役于1863年5月12日在密西西比州雷蒙德附近发生，是美国内战维克斯堡战役的一部分。激烈战斗的双方分别是尤利西斯·S·格兰特少将指挥的田纳西联邦军部分部队，以及约翰·C·彭伯顿中将指挥的密西西比和东路易斯安那邦联部队。邦联军未能阻止联邦军抵达南方铁路，也没能阻断维克斯堡的增援和补给。12日上午，邦联军人数是联邦军的两倍，在十四英里溪对岸面对一支联邦军旅。

en.s: The Battle of Meadow Bridge (also known as Meadow Bridges and the Battle of Richmond Heights) was an engagement on May 12, 1864, in Henrico County, Virginia, during Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's Overland Campaign of the American Civil War. Following their victory at the Battle of Yellow Tavern on May 11, Union cavalry under Maj. Gen. Philip H. Sheridan advanced in the direction of the Confederate capital of Richmond. Caught in the narrow area between the fortifications of Richmond and the rain-swollen Chickahominy River, the Union troopers were subjected to fire from the artillery of Confederate Maj. Gen.

zh.s: 草甸桥之战（又称梅多桥之战或里士满高地之战）于 1864 年 5 月 12 日在弗吉尼亚州亨里科县爆发，是尤利西斯·S·格兰特中将领导的美国内战陆路战役的一场交战。5 月 11 日，联邦军在黄酒馆之战获胜后，菲利普·H·谢里登少将率联邦骑兵向南方邦联首都里士满推进。联邦骑兵被困在里士满防御工事和因暴雨涨水的奇克霍米尼河之间的狭窄地带，遭到南方邦联菲茨休·李少将的炮火攻击。

en.s: The Battle of Proctor's Creek, also known as Drewry's Bluff or Fort Darling, was fought May 12–16, 1864, in Chesterfield County, Virginia, during the Bermuda Hundred Campaign of the American Civil War. Proctor's Creek was named for Charles Proctor, who lived and farmed on the land surrounding most of the creek.

zh.s: 普罗克特溪战役又称德鲁里崖战役或达令堡战役，于1864年5月12日至16日在切斯特菲尔德县发生，是美国内战百慕大百人战役的一部分。普罗克特溪的名称来自查尔斯·普罗克特，他在溪流周边的大部分土地上居住并经营农场。

en.s: The Battle of Spotsylvania Court House, sometimes more simply referred to as the Battle of Spotsylvania (or the 19th-century spelling Spottsylvania), was the second major battle in Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant and Maj. Gen. George G. Meade's 1864 Overland Campaign of the American Civil War. Following the bloody but inconclusive Battle of the Wilderness, Grant's army disengaged from Confederate General Robert E.
en.n: American Civil War: The Battle of Spotsylvania Court House: Union troops assault a Confederate salient known as the "Mule Shoe", with some of the fiercest fighting of the war, much of it hand-to-hand combat, occurring at "the Bloody Angle" on the northwest.

zh.t: 斯波茨尔维尼亚法院之战
zh.s: 斯波茨尔维尼亚法院之战有时简称斯波茨尔维尼亚战役，19世纪也曾拼作Spottsylvania。这是尤利西斯·S·格兰特中将和乔治·G·米德少将在1864年美国内战陆上战役中的第二场主要战斗。在血腥但未分胜负的荒野之战后，格兰特的军队脱离了罗伯特·E·李将军的邦联军。
zh.n: 美国内战：斯波茨尔维尼亚法院之战中，联邦军袭击了邦联军一处名为“骡蹄”的突出阵地。战争中最激烈的战斗之一在此发生，其中许多是近身肉搏，尤其集中在西北部的“血腥角”。

en.s: The Battle of Palmito Ranch, also known as the Battle of Palmito Hill, is considered by some criteria the final battle of the American Civil War. It was fought May 12 and 13, 1865, on the banks of the Rio Grande east of Brownsville, Texas, and a few miles from the seaport of Los Brazos de Santiago, at the southern tip of Texas.
en.n: American Civil War: The Battle of Palmito Ranch: The first day of the last major land action to take place during the Civil War, resulting in a Confederate victory.

zh.s: 帕尔米托牧场战役又称帕尔米托山战役，有些观点认为这是美国内战的最后一场战役。战斗于1865年5月12日至13日在得克萨斯州南端、布朗斯维尔以东的格兰德河畔举行，距圣地亚哥洛斯布拉索斯海港数英里。
zh.n: 美国内战：帕尔米托牧场战役最后一场主要陆上行动的第一天，邦联军获胜。

en.s: The Battle of the Apa River was a military confrontation on May 12 1867 between Brazilian and Paraguayan forces on a farm near the José Carlos stream, on the right bank of the Apa River, in the province of Mato Grosso do Sul, on the border between the belligerents. During the Paraguayan occupation of the province, the invaders had dominated a farm in the region, later renamed Fazenda Marechal López, where the ultimate combat took place.

zh.s: 阿帕河战役是1867年5月12日巴西军队与巴拉圭军队之间的一场军事冲突，战斗发生在交战双方边境、南马托格罗索省阿帕河右岸一条名为若泽·卡洛斯的小溪附近的一处农场。巴拉圭占领该省期间，入侵部队控制了当地一处农场，后来该农场更名为马雷沙尔·洛佩斯庄园；最终交战就在此处发生。

en.s: The Battle of Batoche was the decisive battle of the North-West Resistance, which pitted Canadian Militia units against a force of First Nations and Métis people. Fought from May 9 to 12, 1885, at the ad hoc Provisional Government of Saskatchewan capital of Batoche, the greater numbers and superior firepower of General Frederick Middleton's force eventually overwhelmed the Métis fighters.
en.n: North-West Rebellion: The four-day Battle of Batoche, pitting rebel Métis against the Canadian government, comes to an end with a decisive rebel defeat.

zh.s: 巴托什战役是西北起义的决定性战役，交战双方是加拿大民兵部队，以及原住民和梅蒂人组成的队伍。战斗于1885年5月9日至12日在巴托什举行，当时这里是萨斯喀彻温临时政府的临时首府。弗雷德里克·米德尔顿将军的部队人数更多、火力更强，最终压倒了梅蒂战士。
zh.n: 西北起义：为期四天的巴托什战役结束，反叛的梅蒂人遭加拿大政府军决定性击败。

en.s: The Bombardment of San Juan, or the First Battle of San Juan, on 12 May 1898 was an engagement between United States Navy warships and the Spanish fortifications of San Juan, Puerto Rico. It was the first major action of the Puerto Rican Campaign during the Spanish–American War.

zh.s: 1898年5月12日，美国海军舰艇与西班牙在波多黎各圣胡安的防御工事交战。这场战斗又称圣胡安第一战役，是美西战争期间波多黎各战役中的第一场重大军事行动。

en.s: The Montrose Burghs by-election of 1908 was held on 12 May 1908. The by-election was held due to the elevation to the peerage of the incumbent Liberal MP, John Morley. It was won by the Liberal candidate Robert Venables Vernon Harcourt.

zh.s: 1908年蒙特罗斯伯格斯选区补选于5月12日举行。此次补选是因为现任自由党议员约翰·莫利获封贵族。自由党候选人罗伯特·维纳布尔斯·弗农·哈考特赢得选举。

en.s: The 1914 Great Grimsby by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 12 May 1914. The constituency returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system. It was one of the last by-election contests to take place before the outbreak of the Great War, and provided a good indicator of how the main parties would have performed at an anticipated general election for 1914 or 1915.

zh.s: 1914年大格里姆斯比选区补选于1914年5月12日举行。这一选区选出一名英国下议院议员，采用简单多数制。这是第一次世界大战爆发前最后几场补选之一，也可用来观察各主要政党在预计于1914年或1915年举行的大选中可能取得的成绩。

en.s: The 1918 Copa del Rey final was an association football match between Real Unión and Madrid FC on 12 May 1918, at the O'Donnell Stadium in Madrid. It was the deciding match of the Spanish cup competition, the Copa del Rey. Real Unión beat Madrid FC 2–0 to win their first title. Unión's captain, forward Juan Legarreta, scored both goals. The final was attended by approximately 10,000 spectators.

zh.s: 1918年西班牙国王杯决赛于1918年5月12日在马德里的奥唐奈球场举行，对阵双方是皇家联合和马德里足球俱乐部。这场比赛决定了西班牙国王杯的冠军归属。皇家联合以2比0击败马德里，首次夺冠。球队队长兼前锋胡安·莱加雷塔打入两球。现场约有10,000名观众。

en.s: The Judenburg mutiny was an armed rebellion that took place in the town of Judenburg, Austria-Hungary in May 1918. The mutiny was motivated by unwillingness of some military personnel to serve Austria-Hungary during the latter part of World War I. This incident came in the final stages of the war as a result of several other rebellions within the military of Austria-Hungary sparked by length of the conflict and a difficult situation on the Isonzo front.

zh.s: 1918年5月，奥匈帝国尤登堡镇发生武装叛乱。一些军人不愿在第一次世界大战后期继续为奥匈帝国作战，因而发动兵变。这是战争末期奥匈军队内部一系列叛乱之一；冲突拖延和伊松佐前线的艰难局势都促成了这些叛乱。

en.s: The Red Army invasion of Azerbaijan, also known as the Sovietization or Soviet invasion of Azerbaijan, took place in April 1920. It was a military campaign conducted by the 11th Army of the Soviet Russia aimed at installing a Soviet government in the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic. The invasion coincided with an anti-government insurrection organized by local Azerbaijani Bolsheviks in the capital city of Baku.

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 12 May 1923 to elect the 72 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The Labor government was seeking its fourth continuous term in office since the 1915 election; it would be Premier Ted Theodore's second election.

zh.s: 1923年5月12日，澳大利亚昆士兰州举行选举，选出州立法议会的72名议员。工党政府自1915年选举以来一直执政，正在争取连续第四个任期；这也是泰德·西奥多担任州长期间的第二次选举。

en.s: A general strike took place in the United Kingdom from 4 to 12 May 1926. It was called by the General Council of the Trades Union Congress (TUC) in an unsuccessful attempt to force the British government to act to prevent wage reductions and worsening conditions for 1.2 million locked-out coal miners. Some 1.7 million workers went out, especially in transport and heavy industry.
en.n: The 1926 United Kingdom general strike ends.

zh.s: 1926年5月4日至12日，英国发生总罢工。英国工会大会总理事会发起罢工，试图阻止英国政府削减工资并改善120万名被停工煤矿工人的处境，但未能成功。约170万名工人参加罢工，尤以交通运输和重工业领域为多。
zh.n: 1926年英国总罢工结束。

en.t: 1931 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: There were special elections to the United States House of Representatives in 1931 to the 71st United States Congress and 72nd United States Congress. After the 1930 House elections, the Republicans held a narrow majority of 218 seats, the smallest possible majority in congress. en.s: Charles Augustus Lindbergh (February 4, 1902 – August 26, 1974) was an American aviator, military officer, and author. On May 20–21, 1927, he made the first nonstop flight from New York to Paris, a distance of 3,600 miles (5,800 km), flying alone for over 33 hours. His aircraft, the Spirit of St. Louis, was built to compete for the $25,000 Orteig Prize for the first flight between the two cities.

zh.t: 林德伯格年幼的儿子查尔斯被绑架十周后，在新泽西州霍普韦尔附近被发现死亡
zh.s: 查尔斯·奥古斯都·林德伯格（1902年2月4日—1974年8月26日）是美国飞行员、军官和作家。1927年5月20日至21日，他独自驾驶飞机连续飞行33小时以上，从纽约飞抵巴黎，航程3,600英里（5,800公里），完成首次跨大西洋不着陆飞行。他的飞机“圣路易斯精神号”是为争夺两城间首次飞行的2.5万美元奥泰格奖而建造的。

en.t: The Agricultural Adjustment Act, which restricts agricultural production through government purchase of livestock for slaughter and paying subsidies to farmers when they remove land from planting, is signed into law by President Franklin D. Roosevelt
en.s: The Agricultural Adjustment Act (AAA) of 1933 was a United States federal law of the New Deal era designed to boost agricultural prices by reducing surpluses. The government bought livestock for slaughter and paid farmers subsidies not to plant on part of their land. en.s: The Second Battle of Kharkov, was an Axis counter-offensive in the region around Kharkov (now Kharkiv) against the Red Army Izium bridgehead offensive conducted 12–28 May 1942, on the Eastern Front during World War II. Its objective was to eliminate the Izium bridgehead over Seversky Donets or the "Barvenkovo bulge" (Russian: Барвенковский выступ) which was one of the Soviet offensive's staging areas. After a winter counter-offensive that drove German troops away from Moscow and also depleted the Red Army's reserves, the Kharkov offensive was a new Soviet attempt to expand upon their strategic initiative, although it failed to secure a significant element of surprise.

zh.s: 珊瑚—巴尔莫勒尔战役是越南战争期间于1968年5月12日至6月6日发生的一系列战斗。交战双方是澳大利亚第一特遣部队（1 ATF），以及越南人民军第7师和越共主力部队。战场位于西贡东北约40公里（25英里）处。

en.s: Elections to the Zetland County Council were held on 12 May 1970 as part of Scottish local elections. Elections were held in every part of Shetland except Lerwick to elect 24 landward members to the County Council, who would be joined by nine nominated members from the Lerwick Town Council. Only five of 24 seats were contested.

zh.s: 1970年5月12日，设得兰群岛郡议会举行选举，属于苏格兰地方选举的一部分。除勒威克外，设得兰群岛各地均举行投票，选出24名乡村地区议员；勒威克镇议会另提名9名议员加入郡议会。24个席位中只有5个有竞争。

en.s: The 24th Cannes Film Festival was held on May 12 - 27, 1971. The Palme d'Or went to The Go-Between by Joseph Losey. The festival opened with Gimme Shelter, a documentary about English rock band The Rolling Stones directed by David Maysles, Albert Maysles and Charlotte Zwerin and closed with Les mariés de l'an II, directed by Jean-Paul Rappeneau. The festival paid tribute to Charlie Chaplin and honored him with the title of Commander of the national order of the Legion of Honor.

zh.s: 第24届戛纳电影节于1971年5月12日至27日举行。约瑟夫·罗西执导的《信使》获得金棕榈奖。电影节以迈斯莱斯兄弟和夏洛特·兹沃林执导的滚石乐队纪录片《给我庇护》开幕，以让-保罗·拉佩诺执导的《新婚夫妇》闭幕。电影节向查理·卓别林致敬，并授予他法国荣誉军团勋章骑士称号。

en.s: The 1976 European Cup final was a football match held at Hampden Park, Glasgow, on 12 May 1976, that saw Bayern Munich of West Germany defeat Saint-Étienne of France 1–0. This was the third consecutive European Cup title for Bayern, making them the third club to achieve this feat, following Real Madrid and Ajax.

zh.s: 1976年欧洲冠军杯决赛于1976年5月12日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行。西德的拜仁慕尼黑以1比0击败法国的圣埃蒂安，第三次连续夺得欧洲冠军杯冠军。拜仁由此成为第三支实现这一成就的球队，此前只有皇家马德里和阿贾克斯做到过。

en.s: The 1979 FA Cup final was a football match played on 12 May 1979 at Wembley Stadium. The match was contested by Arsenal and Manchester United. It is regarded as one of the greatest-ever finishes in an FA Cup final. For over 85 minutes the game had been unremarkable, with Arsenal taking a 2–0 half time lead through goals from Brian Talbot and Frank Stapleton.

zh.s: 1979年英格兰足总杯决赛于5月12日在温布利球场举行，参赛球队是阿森纳和曼联。这场决赛以最后阶段的精彩逆转而闻名。此前85分钟比赛波澜不惊，阿森纳凭布赖恩·塔尔博特和弗兰克·斯特普尔顿的进球，以2比0领先结束上半场。

en.s: The 1979 Scottish Cup Final was contested between Rangers and Hibernian. After goalless draws in the initial match and the replay, Rangers won the Cup by winning 3–2 after extra time in the second replay. The winning goal for Rangers was an own goal scored with his head by Arthur Duncan.

zh.s: 1979年苏格兰杯决赛由格拉斯哥流浪者对阵希伯尼安。双方在首场比赛和重赛中都未能进球；在第二次重赛中，流浪者加时赛以3比2获胜，夺得苏格兰杯。流浪者的制胜球是亚瑟·邓肯头球打进的乌龙球。

en.s: The 1982 European Cup Winners' Cup Final was a football match contested between Barcelona of Spain and Standard Liège of Belgium. It was the final match of the 1981–82 European Cup Winners' Cup and the 22nd European Cup Winners' Cup final. The final was held on 12 May 1982 at Camp Nou in Barcelona, Spain, the home ground of FC Barcelona.

zh.s: 1982年欧洲优胜者杯决赛是一场足球比赛，参赛双方是西班牙的巴塞罗那和比利时的标准列日。这是1981—82赛季欧洲优胜者杯的决赛，也是该赛事历史上的第22场决赛。比赛于1982年5月12日在西班牙巴塞罗那的诺坎普球场举行，该球场是巴塞罗那足球俱乐部的主场。

en.s: Mary was a first-century Jewish woman of Nazareth, the wife of Joseph and the mother of Jesus. She is an important figure of Christianity, venerated under various titles such as virgin or queen, many of which are mentioned in the Litany of Loreto. The Eastern and Oriental Orthodox, Catholic, Lutheran, Reformed, Anglican, and Methodist churches believe that Mary, as mother of Jesus, is the Mother of God.

zh.t: 葡萄牙法蒂玛圣母朝圣地外，保安制服企图用刺刀袭击教宗若望·保禄二世的胡安·玛丽亚·费尔南德斯·克龙
zh.s: 玛利亚是公元一世纪生活在拿撒勒的犹太女性，是约瑟的妻子、耶稣的母亲。她是基督教的重要人物，受到多个称号的敬奉，例如“圣母”和“女王”，其中不少称号见于《洛雷托祷文》。东正教、东方正统教会、天主教、路德宗、归正宗、圣公会和卫理公会都认为，作为耶稣的母亲，玛利亚是天主之母。

en.s: The 1985 North Rhine-Westphalia state election was held on 12 May 1985 to elect the 10th Landtag of North Rhine-Westphalia. The outgoing government was a majority of the Social Democratic Party (SPD), led by Minister-President Johannes Rau. The SPD won re-election in a landslide, recording their best-ever result with 52.1% of votes. The opposition Christian Democratic Union (CDU) suffered their worst result up until this point with 36.5%.

zh.t: 1985年北莱茵-威斯特法伦州选举
zh.s: 1985年5月12日，北莱茵-威斯特法伦州举行选举，选出第十届州议会。即将卸任的政府由约翰内斯·劳领导，社会民主党（SPD）在议会中占多数。社会民主党以压倒性优势连任，得票率达52.1%，创下该党当时的最佳成绩。基督教民主联盟（CDU）的得票率为36.5%，创下当时该党的最差成绩。

en.s: The 1985 WFA Cup Final was the 15th final of the WFA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was played under the auspices of the Women's Football Association (WFA). Friends of Fulham and Doncaster Belles contested the match at Craven Cottage, the home stadium of Fulham F.C. on 12 May 1985. Friends of Fulham ended up winning the game 2–0.

zh.s: 1985年英格兰女子足总杯决赛是该赛事的第15场决赛，也是英格兰女子足球的主要杯赛。比赛由女子足球协会主办，于1985年5月12日在富勒姆足球俱乐部主场克雷文小屋球场举行，对阵双方是富勒姆之友队和唐卡斯特贝尔斯队。富勒姆之友队以2比0获胜。

en.s: General elections were held in Nepal on 12 May 1986 to elect members of the Rastriya Panchayat. As political parties were banned at the time, all 1,548 candidates ran as independents. Voter turnout was 60%.

zh.s: 尼泊尔于1986年5月12日举行大选，选出国家评议会成员。当时政治党派遭禁，所有1,548名候选人均以独立人士身份参选。投票率为60%。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Kiribati on 12 May 1987. The result was a victory for incumbent Ieremia Tabai, who won 50.1% of the vote. Voter turnout was 78.3%.

zh.s: 基里巴斯于1987年5月12日举行总统选举。现任总统耶雷米亚·塔拜以50.1%的得票率获胜。投票率为78.3%。

en.s: The San Bernardino train disaster, sometimes known as the Duffy Street incident, was a combination of two separate but related incidents that occurred in San Bernardino, California, United States: a runaway train derailment on May 12, 1989; and the subsequent failure on May 25, 1989, of the Calnev Pipeline, a petroleum pipeline adjacent to the tracks which was damaged by earth-moving equipment during the crash cleanup.

zh.s: 圣贝纳迪诺列车事故又称达菲街事故，由美国加利福尼亚州圣贝纳迪诺发生的两起相关事件组成：1989年5月12日，一列失控列车脱轨；5月25日，靠近铁轨的卡尔内夫石油管道随后破裂。管道在列车事故清理期间被土方设备损坏。

en.s: The 1990 Scottish Cup Final was the 105th final of the Scottish Cup, Scottish football's most prestigious knock-out association football competition. The match took place at Hampden Park on 12 May 1990 and was contested by Scottish Premier Division clubs Aberdeen and Celtic. It was Aberdeen's 13th and Celtic's 45th Scottish Cup Final. The clubs had previously met at the same stage of the tournament on five occasions.

zh.s: 1990年苏格兰杯决赛是苏格兰足球最重要的淘汰赛——苏格兰杯的第105场决赛。比赛于1990年5月12日在汉普顿公园球场举行，对阵双方是苏格兰超级联赛球队阿伯丁和凯尔特人。这是阿伯丁第13次、凯尔特人第45次参加苏格兰杯决赛。两队此前曾在该赛事决赛阶段交手五次。

en.s: General elections were held in Nepal on 12 May 1991, to elect 205 members to the House of Representatives. The elections were the first multi-party elections since 1959 and were a result of the 1990 revolution forcing King Birendra to restore a multi-party system. Although the Nepali Congress won the most seats, its leader Krishna Prasad Bhattarai lost in his own constituency, Kathmandu 1.

zh.s: 尼泊尔于1991年5月12日举行大选，选出205名众议院议员。这是1959年以来首次举行多党选举，此前1990年革命迫使比兰德拉国王恢复多党制。尼泊尔大会党赢得最多席位，但该党领袖克里希纳·普拉萨德·巴塔拉伊在加德满都第一区落选。

en.s: The 1993 European Cup Winners' Cup final was a football match contested between Parma of Italy and Antwerp of Belgium. The final was held at Wembley Stadium in London, England on 12 May 1993. It was the final match of the 1992–93 European Cup Winners' Cup and the 33rd European Cup Winners' Cup final. Parma beat Antwerp 3–1 and in doing so became the eighth different Italian team to win a European trophy.

zh.s: 1993年欧洲优胜者杯决赛是一场足球比赛，参赛双方是意大利的帕尔马和比利时的安特卫普。比赛于1993年5月12日在英格兰伦敦的温布利球场举行。这是1992—93赛季欧洲优胜者杯的决赛，也是该赛事历史上的第33场决赛。帕尔马以3比1击败安特卫普，成为第八支赢得欧洲赛事冠军的意大利球队。

en.s: The 1993 Greek Cup final was the 49th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 12 May 1993 at the Olympic Stadium. The contesting teams were Olympiacos and Panathinaikos. It was Olympiacos' twenty-seventh Greek Cup final and second consecutive in their 68 years of existence and Panathinaikos' twentieth Greek Cup finalin their 85-year history. Before the match, the manager of Olympiacos Nikos Alefantos had a peculiar idea.

zh.s: 1993年希腊杯决赛是该赛事的第49场决赛，于1993年5月12日在奥林匹克体育场举行。参赛双方是奥林匹亚科斯和帕纳辛奈科斯。这是奥林匹亚科斯队史第27次闯入希腊杯决赛，也是他们68年队史中连续第二年进入决赛；帕纳辛奈科斯则是队史第20次进入决赛，当时该队成立已有85年。赛前，奥林匹亚科斯主教练尼科斯·阿莱凡托斯提出了一个不同寻常的想法。

en.s: The 1993 North Sumatra gubernatorial election was an indirect election held to elect the Governor of North Sumatra for the 1993—1998 term. All members of the Regional People's Representative Council of North Sumatra were eligible to vote during this election.

zh.s: 1993年北苏门答腊省长选举是一次间接选举，选出1993至1998年任期的北苏门答腊省省长。北苏门答腊地区人民代表理事会的全体成员都有权投票。

en.s: The 47th Cannes Film Festival took place from 12 to 23 May 1994. American filmmaker and actor Clint Eastwood served as jury president for the main competition. French actress Jeanne Moreau hosted the opening and closing ceremonies. American filmmaker Quentin Tarantino won the Palme d'Or, the festival's top prize, for the comedy-drama film Pulp Fiction. The festival opened with The Hudsucker Proxy by Joel Coen, and closed with Serial Mom by John Waters.

zh.s: 第47届戛纳电影节于1994年5月12日至23日举行。美国导演兼演员克林特·伊斯特伍德担任主竞赛单元评审团主席。法国女演员让娜·莫罗主持开幕式和闭幕式。美国导演昆汀·塔伦蒂诺凭剧情喜剧片《低俗小说》获得金棕榈奖。电影节以乔尔·科恩执导的《金钱帝国》开幕，以约翰·沃特斯执导的《哭泣宝贝》闭幕。

en.s: Island council elections were held in the Netherlands Antilles on 7 April (Bonaire and Sint Maarten) and 12 May 1995 (Curaçao, Saba and Sint Eustatius) to elect the members of the island councils of its five island territories. The election was won by the Bonaire Democratic Party (5 seats) in Bonaire, the Party for the Restructured Antilles (8 seats) in Curaçao, the Saba Democratic Labour Movement (3 seats) in Saba, the Democratic Party Statia (3 seats) in Sint Eustatius, and the Democratic Party (7 seats) in Sint Maarten.

zh.t: 1995年荷属安的列斯群岛岛屿议会选举
zh.s: 荷属安的列斯群岛于1995年4月7日（博内尔和圣马丁）及5月12日（库拉索、萨巴和圣尤斯特歇斯）举行岛屿议会选举，为五个岛屿地区选出议员。各岛获胜政党及席位数分别为：博内尔民主党5席、库拉索安的列斯重组党8席、萨巴民主工运党3席、圣尤斯特歇斯民主党3席，以及圣马丁民主党7席。

en.s: The 1998 election for Mayor of Newark took place in Newark, the most populous city in the state of New Jersey, on May 12, 1998. Elections for all seats on the nine-member Municipal Council of Newark were held the same day. A runoff election, if necessary, would have taken place. Elections in the city are non-partisan and candidates are not listed by political party.

zh.s: 纽瓦克市长选举于1998年5月12日在新泽西州人口最多的城市纽瓦克举行。同一天，纽瓦克九人市政委员会的所有席位也进行选举。如有必要，将举行第二轮投票。该市选举不设党派，候选人名单上也不标注党派。

en.s: The 52nd Cannes Film Festival was held on May 12–23, 1999. The Palme d'Or went to the French-Belgian film Rosetta by Jean-Pierre and Luc Dardenne. The festival opened with The Barber of Siberia, directed by Nikita Mikhalkov and closed with An Ideal Husband, directed by Oliver Parker.

zh.s: 第52届戛纳电影节于1999年5月12日至23日举行。法国和比利时导演让-皮埃尔·达内与吕克·达内执导的法国比利时合拍片《罗塞塔》获得金棕榈奖。电影节以尼基塔·米哈尔科夫执导的《西伯利亚的理发师》开幕，以奥利弗·帕克执导的《理想丈夫》闭幕。

en.s: The 1999 UEFA Cup final was an association football match played on 12 May 1999 at the Luzhniki Stadium in Moscow to determine the winners of the 1998–99 UEFA Cup. The match was contested by Parma of Italy and Marseille of France. Parma won the match 3–0 to claim their second UEFA Cup and fourth European trophy, having previously won the UEFA Cup Winners' Cup and the UEFA Super Cup on one occasion each.

zh.s: 1999年欧洲联盟杯决赛于1999年5月12日在莫斯科卢日尼基体育场举行，决出1998—99赛季欧洲联盟杯冠军。参赛双方是意大利的帕尔马和法国的马赛。帕尔马以3比0获胜，第二次夺得欧洲联盟杯冠军，并拿下队史第四座欧洲奖杯；此前他们曾各一次赢得欧洲优胜者杯和欧洲超级杯。

en.s: The 2001 FA Cup final was a football match between Arsenal and Liverpool on 12 May 2001 at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff. It was the final match of the 2000–01 FA Cup, the 120th season of the world's oldest football knockout competition, the FA Cup, and the first in the competition's history to be staged outside England, due to the ongoing reconstruction of its usual venue, Wembley Stadium.

zh.s: 2001年英格兰足总杯决赛于2001年5月12日在卡迪夫千禧球场举行，对阵双方是阿森纳和利物浦。这是2000—01赛季足总杯的最后一场比赛，也是世界上历史最悠久的足球淘汰赛第120个赛季的决赛。由于温布利球场正在重建，这场决赛首次在英格兰以外的地方举行。

en.s: The 2001 Greek Cup final was the 57th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 12 May 2001 at Nikos Goumas Stadium. The contesting teams were Olympiacos and PAOK. It was Olympiacos' twenty-ninth Greek Cup final in their 76 years of existence and PAOK's fifteenth Greek Cup final in their 75-year history.

zh.s: 2001年希腊杯决赛是该赛事的第57场决赛，于2001年5月12日在尼科斯·古马斯球场举行。参赛双方是奥林匹亚科斯和塞萨洛尼基PAOK队。这是奥林匹亚科斯队史第29次参加希腊杯决赛，当时该队成立76年；PAOK则是队史第15次参赛，当时该队成立75年。

en.t: 2002 Football League First Division play-off final
en.s: The 2002 Football League First Division play-off final was an association football match between Birmingham City and Norwich City held on 12 May 2002 at the Millennium Stadium in Cardiff, Wales. It was held to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the Football League First Division, the second tier of English football, to the Premiership.

zh.t: 2002年英格兰足球甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2002年英格兰足球甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2002年5月12日在威尔士卡迪夫的千禧球场举行，对阵双方是伯明翰城和诺维奇城。这场比赛决定哪支球队获得最后一个升级名额，从英格兰足球第二级别甲级联赛升入英超。

en.s: The 2002 FA Trophy Final was the 33rd final of the Football Association's cup competition for levels 5–8 of the English football league system. The match was contested by Stevenage Borough and Yeovil Town on 12 May 2002 at Villa Park in Birmingham. Yeovil won the match 2–0 to win the competition for the first time in their history.

zh.s: 2002年英格兰足总锦标赛决赛是英格兰足总为英格兰足球联赛体系第5至第8级球队举办的杯赛的第33场决赛。比赛于2002年5月12日在伯明翰维拉公园球场举行，对阵双方是斯蒂夫尼奇自治市和约维尔镇。约维尔以2比0获胜，队史首次夺得该项赛事冠军。

en.s: The 2002 Taça de Portugal final was the final match of the 2001–02 Taça de Portugal, the 62nd season of the Taça de Portugal, the premier Portuguese football cup competition organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 12 May 2002 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, and opposed third division side Leixões and Sporting CP.

zh.s: 2002年葡萄牙杯决赛是2001—02赛季葡萄牙杯的最后一场比赛，也是该项由葡萄牙足球协会主办的顶级杯赛第62个赛季的决赛。比赛于2002年5月12日在奥埃拉什的国家体育场举行，对阵双方是葡乙球队莱雄伊什和葡萄牙体育。

en.s: The 2002 National Soccer League Grand Final was held on 12 May 2002 between Perth Glory and Olympic Sharks at Subiaco Oval. Olympic Sharks won the match 1–0, with the goal coming from Ante Milicic. Milicic also won the Joe Marston Medal.

zh.t: 2002年澳大利亚全国足球联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2002年澳大利亚全国足球联赛总决赛于2002年5月12日举行，对阵双方是珀斯光荣和奥林匹克鲨鱼队，比赛地点为苏比亚科椭圆球场。奥林匹克鲨鱼队以1比0获胜，安特·米利契奇打入全场唯一进球。米利契奇还获得乔·马斯顿奖章。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Mali on 28 April 2002, with a run-off on 12 May. The previous president, Alpha Oumar Konaré, stood down after 10 years in office, having been term limited by the Malian constitution to two terms. Amadou Toumani Touré won the election with 65% of the vote in the second round.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 马里于2002年4月28日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于5月12日举行。前总统阿尔法·乌马尔·科纳雷受宪法两届任期限制，在执政10年后卸任。阿马杜·图马尼·杜尔在第二轮中以65%的得票率胜出。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: Two major bombings took place in residential compounds in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia in 2003. On 12 May 2003, 39 people were killed, and over 160 wounded when bombs went off at three compounds in Riyadh—Dorrat Al Jadawel, Al Hamra Oasis Village, and the Vinnell Corporation Compound. On 8 November, a bomb was detonated outside the Al-Mohaya housing compound west of Riyadh, killing at least 17 people and wounding 122. The bombings have been attributed to Islamic extremists as part of a campaign against Westerners and Westernization in Saudi Arabia.

zh.s: 2003年，沙特阿拉伯利雅得的住宅区发生两次重大爆炸。5月12日，达拉特·贾达维尔、哈姆拉绿洲村和维内尔公司住宅区三处发生炸弹爆炸，造成39人死亡、160多人受伤。11月8日，穆海亚住宅区外发生炸弹爆炸，至少17人死亡、122人受伤。这些爆炸被归因于伊斯兰极端分子针对西方人及西方化发起的行动。

en.s: A special election for Isabela's 4th district seat in the House of Representatives of the Philippines was held on May 12, 2003. Held due to the death of Antonio Abaya, Giorgidi Aggabao won the special election, beating Abaya's widow Asuncion, to succeed him in the House of Representatives.

zh.t: 2003年伊莎贝拉省第四国会选区补选
zh.s: 菲律宾众议院伊莎贝拉省第四选区于2003年5月12日举行补选。此次补选是因安东尼奥·阿巴亚去世而举行。乔尔吉迪·阿加包击败阿巴亚的遗孀阿松西翁，赢得补选并接替他进入众议院。

en.s: The 2004 Bulgarian Cup final was played at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia on 12 May 2004 and was contested between the sides of Litex Lovech and CSKA Sofia. The match was won by Litex Lovech.

zh.s: 2004年保加利亚杯决赛于2004年5月12日在索非亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行，对阵双方是洛维奇足球俱乐部和索非亚中央陆军。洛维奇获胜。

en.s: The 57th Cannes Film Festival took place from 12 to 23 May 2004. American filmmaker Quentin Tarantino served as jury president for the main competition. While American filmmaker Michael Moore won the Palme d'Or for the documentary film Fahrenheit 9/11, becoming the first documentary to win the festival's main prize since The Silent World in 1956.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第57届戛纳电影节于2004年5月12日至23日举行。美国导演昆汀·塔伦蒂诺担任主竞赛单元评审团主席。美国导演迈克尔·摩尔凭纪录片《华氏911》获得金棕榈奖。这是自1956年《沉默的世界》获奖以来，首部获得电影节最高奖的纪录片。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 2005 election for mayor of Chattogram City Corporation was held on 12 May 2005.The result was a victory again for the Bangladesh Awami League candidate A B M Mohiuddin Chowdhury. He beat Mir Mohammed Nasiruddin, the Bangladesh Nationalist Party's candidate and previous mayor who was appointed to his post.

zh.s: 吉大港市政公司市长选举于2005年5月12日举行。孟加拉国人民联盟候选人A·B·M·莫希丁·乔杜里再次获胜。他击败了孟加拉国民族主义党候选人、曾由任命出任市长的米尔·穆罕默德·纳西尔丁。

en.s: The Battle of Point Pedro was a naval battle that occurred on May 12, 2006 near Point Pedro, Jaffna, Sri Lanka. The Sri Lankan Navy was attacked by a group of Tamil Tiger boats. A group of SLN attack boats was escorting a troop transport, the MV Pearl Cruise II which was carrying 710 soldiers for the city of Jaffna which had been under siege for the previous six years. About 15 Sea Tiger boats, including suicide boats, were engaged in the battle. One navy and five Tiger boats were sunk. The navy boat was sunk by an LTTE suicide boat.

zh.s: 佩德罗角海战是2006年5月12日在斯里兰卡贾夫纳佩德罗角附近发生的一场海战。斯里兰卡海军遭泰米尔猛虎组织的一支船队袭击。当时，一队海军攻击艇正在护送运兵船“珍珠邮轮二号”，船上载有710名士兵，前往被围困六年的贾夫纳市。约15艘海虎船只参与交战，其中包括自杀式船只。海战中一艘海军船和五艘泰米尔猛虎组织船只被击沉；海军船是被猛虎组织自杀式船只击沉的。

en.s: The CMLL International Gran Prix (2006) was a lucha libre, or professional wrestling, tournament produced and scripted by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL; "World Wrestling Council" in Spanish) which took place on May 12, 2006 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico, CMLL's main venue. The 2006 International Gran Prix was the ninth time CMLL has held an International Gran Prix tournament since 1994.

zh.s: 2006年CMLL国际大奖赛是一场墨西哥职业摔角赛事，由世界摔角理事会（Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre，CMLL；西班牙语意为“世界摔角理事会”）制作并编排。比赛于2006年5月12日在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行，该场馆是CMLL的主要场地。这是CMLL自1994年以来第九次举办国际大奖赛。

en.s: The Iran newspaper cockroach cartoon controversy occurred in response to a cartoon drawn by cartoonist Mana Neyestani and published in the Iranian Friday-magazine Iran-e-jomee on 12 May 2006. The cartoon describes nine methods of dealing with cockroaches by depicting a Persian-speaking child and a cockroach. During the first method, when the cockroach does not understand him, the child decides to talk to the cockroach in "cockroach language", but the cockroach replies by saying "Namana?"
en.n: The Iran newspaper cockroach cartoon controversy occurred in response to a cartoon drawn by cartoonist Mana Neyestani and published in the Iranian Friday-magazine Iran-e-jomee on 12 May 2006.

zh.t: 伊朗报纸蟑螂漫画争议
zh.s: 这场争议源于漫画家马纳·尼亚斯塔尼绘制的一幅漫画。漫画于2006年5月12日刊登在伊朗周五杂志《伊朗周报》上，描绘一名说波斯语的孩子和一只蟑螂，并列出九种处理蟑螂的方法。第一种方法中，蟑螂听不懂孩子说的话，于是孩子决定改用“蟑螂语”交谈；蟑螂回答：“Namana？”
zh.n: 伊朗报纸蟑螂漫画争议源于漫画家马纳·尼亚斯塔尼绘制的一幅漫画，该漫画于2006年5月12日刊登在伊朗周五杂志《伊朗周报》上。

en.s: The 2006 São Paulo violence outbreak began on the night of May 12, 2006 in São Paulo, Brazil, the largest city in South America. It was among the worst outbreaks of violence in recorded Brazilian history and was directed against security forces and a few civilian targets. By May 14 the attacks had spread to other Brazilian states including Paraná, Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais and Bahia (this without direct links to the PCC criminal organisation).
en.n: The 2006 São Paulo violence outbreak began on the night of May 12, 2006 in São Paulo, Brazil, the largest city in South America.

zh.s: 2006年5月12日晚，巴西最大城市圣保罗爆发暴力事件。该事件是巴西历史上有记录以来最严重的暴力事件之一，袭击目标包括安全部队和少数平民目标。到5月14日，袭击已蔓延至巴西其他州，包括巴拉那州、南马托格罗索州、米纳斯吉拉斯州和巴伊亚州；这些州的袭击与第一司令部犯罪组织（PCC）没有直接关联。
zh.n: 2006年圣保罗暴力事件于2006年5月12日晚在南美洲最大城市巴西圣保罗爆发。

en.s: Respect is Earned (2007) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view promoted by Ring of Honor. It was the promotion's first PPV. It took place on May 12, 2007 from the Manhattan Center in New York, New York, and first aired on PPV on July 1.

zh.s: 《尊重是赢来的》（2007年）是荣誉之戒摔角联盟举办的一场职业摔角付费赛事，也是该联盟首次举办付费赛事。活动于2007年5月12日在纽约市曼哈顿中心举行，随后于7月1日在付费频道播出。

en.s: WEC 27: Marshall vs. McElfresh was the third mixed martial arts event held by the World Extreme Cagefighting under Zuffa management. The event was held on May 12, 2007. UFC lightweight fighter and future WEC Lightweight Champion Jamie Varner was expected to make his promotional debut on this card against Richard Crunkilton, but the fight was removed from the card after Varner suffered training injuries.

zh.s: WEC 27：马歇尔对阵麦克埃尔弗雷什，是世界极限笼斗联盟在祖法公司管理下举办的第三场综合格斗赛事。赛事于2007年5月12日举行。UFC轻量级选手、后来成为WEC轻量级冠军的杰米·瓦尔纳原计划在本场比赛中首次亮相，对手是理查德·克伦克尔顿；但瓦尔纳训练受伤后，这场比赛从赛程中取消。

en.s: 2007 Keelung mayoral by-election was held on 12 May 2007, three months after the death of incumbent mayor Hsu Tsai-li. Chang Tong-rong from the Kuomintang (KMT) defeated the other four candidates and held the mayorship for the party with 47% of votes.

zh.s: 2007年基隆市长补选于2007年5月12日举行，距时任市长许财利去世三个月。中国国民党候选人张通荣击败另外四名候选人，以47%的得票率胜出，为该党保住市长职位。

en.s: The 2007 Fort Worth mayoral election took place on May 12, 2007, to elect the Mayor of Fort Worth, Texas. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and was officially nonpartisan. The election saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Mike Moncrief. The mayoral term in Fort Worth is two years. If no candidate received a majority of the vote in the general election, a runoff would have been held.

zh.s: 2007年沃思堡市长选举于2007年5月12日举行，选出得克萨斯州沃思堡市长。选举与其他地方选举同时进行，官方上不设党派。现任市长迈克·蒙克里夫成功连任。沃思堡市长任期为两年。如果没有候选人在大选中获得多数票，就会举行第二轮投票。

en.s: The 2007 Dallas mayoral election took place on May 12, 2007, to elect the successor to incumbent Mayor Laura Miller. Miller decided not to run for a second full term. The race is officially nonpartisan. After no candidate received a majority of the votes, the top two candidates – Tom Leppert and Ed Oakley – faced each other in a runoff election on June 16, 2007, in which Leppert prevailed.

zh.s: 2007年达拉斯市长选举于2007年5月12日举行，选出接替时任市长劳拉·米勒的人选。米勒决定不竞选第二个完整任期。选举官方上不设党派。由于没有候选人获得多数票，得票最高的汤姆·莱珀特和埃德·奥克利于2007年6月16日进入第二轮，最终莱珀特胜出。

en.s: The 2007 FA Trophy Final was the 38th final of The Football Association's cup competition for levels 5–8 of the English football league system. It was contested by Kidderminster Harriers and Stevenage Borough, both of the Conference National — the highest tier of the non-league football pyramid. The game was the first competitive match, and final, to be played at the new Wembley Stadium. It was played in front of a record competition crowd of 53,262 on 12 May 2007.

zh.s: 2007年英格兰足总锦标赛决赛是英格兰足总为英格兰足球联赛体系第5至第8级球队举办的杯赛第38场决赛。对阵双方是非联赛体系最高级别全国联赛的基德明斯特哈里尔队和斯蒂夫尼奇自治市。比赛于2007年5月12日在新温布利球场举行，是该球场举办的首场正式比赛和首场决赛。现场观众达53,262人，创下该赛事的观众人数纪录。

en.s: On May 12, 2007, the city of San Antonio, Texas, held an election to choose who would serve as Mayor of San Antonio for a 2-year term to expire in 2009. Incumbent mayor Phil Hardberger won over 77 percent of the vote, securing re-election to a second and final 2-year term.

zh.s: 2007年5月12日，得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥举行选举，选出任期至2009年的市长。现任市长菲尔·哈德伯格获得超过77%的选票，成功连任最后一个两年任期。

en.s: The 2007 Coupe de France final was the final match of the 2006-07 season of Coupe de France, a domestic club football tournament organised by the French Football Federation since 1917. It was held at Stade de France in Saint-Denis on 12 May 2007. It was competed between Olympique de Marseille and FC Sochaux-Montbéliard.

zh.s: 2007年法国杯决赛是2006—07赛季法国杯的最后一场比赛。法国杯是法国足球协会自1917年以来主办的国内俱乐部足球赛事。决赛于2007年5月12日在圣但尼的法兰西体育场举行，参赛双方是马赛奥林匹克和索肖-蒙贝利亚尔足球俱乐部。

en.s: An earthquake occurred in the province of Sichuan, China at 14:28:01 China Standard Time on May 12, 2008. Measuring at 8.0 Ms (7.9–8.3 Mw), the earthquake's epicenter was located 80 kilometres (50 mi) west-northwest of Chengdu, the provincial capital, with a focal depth of 19 km (12 mi). The earthquake ruptured the fault for over 240 km (150 mi), with surface displacements of several meters.

zh.s: 2008年5月12日中国标准时间14时28分01秒，中国四川省发生地震。地震面波震级为8.0级（矩震级为7.9至8.3级），震中位于省会成都西北偏西约80公里（50英里）处，震源深度为19公里（12英里）。地震造成超过240公里（150英里）的断层破裂，地表错动达数米。

en.s: The Postville raid was a raid at the Agriprocessors, Inc., kosher slaughterhouse and meat packing plant in Postville, Iowa, on May 12, 2008, during George W. Bush's Presidency executed by the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) division of the Department of Homeland Security together with other agencies. On that day, ICE deployed 900 agents and arrested 398 employees, 98% of whom were Latino.

zh.s: 波斯特维尔突袭行动于2008年5月12日在爱荷华州波斯特维尔的Agriprocessors公司发生。这家公司经营犹太洁食屠宰场和肉类加工厂。乔治·W·布什总统任期内，美国国土安全部下属移民与海关执法局（ICE）与其他机构联合执行了这次突袭。当天，ICE派出900名执法人员，逮捕398名员工，其中98%是拉丁裔。

en.s: The 2009 Jersey City non-partisan mayoral election occurred on May 12, 2009. Incumbent Mayor Jerramiah Healy (Democrat) won re-election. Former Mayor Bret Schundler (Republican) was going to run, but dropped out in January 2009 for financial reasons. Healy needed a 51% vote to hold off a second round (like the 2004 and 2005 elections). Healy won the election with 53% vote against 4 other candidates.

zh.s: 2009年泽西市市长选举于5月12日举行，采用无党派形式。现任市长杰拉迈亚·希利（民主党）成功连任。前市长布雷特·舒恩德勒（共和党）原计划参选，但因资金问题于2009年1月退出。希利需要获得51%的选票，才能避免进入第二轮（2004年和2005年的选举都举行过第二轮）。他最终以53%的得票率击败另外四名候选人。

en.s: The 2009 British Columbia general election was held on May 12, 2009, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly in the Canadian province of British Columbia. The British Columbia Liberal Party (BC Liberals) formed the government of the province prior to this general election under the leadership of Premier Gordon Campbell. The British Columbia New Democratic Party (BC NDP) under the leadership of Carole James was the Official Opposition.

zh.s: 2009年5月12日，不列颠哥伦比亚省举行大选，选出加拿大该省立法议会议员。此前，省自由党在戈登·坎贝尔省长领导下执政；卡罗尔·詹姆斯领导的不列颠哥伦比亚新民主党则是官方反对党。

en.s: The 2009 Omaha mayoral election was held on May 12, 2009. Incumbent mayor Mike Fahey declined to seek a third term. City Councilman Jim Suttle narrowly defeated former Mayor Hal Daub. This would be the last mayoral race to be won by a Democrat until 2025.

zh.s: 2009年奥马哈市长选举于2009年5月12日举行。现任市长迈克·费伊希决定不竞选第三个任期。市议员吉姆·萨特尔以微弱优势击败前市长哈尔·多布。直到2025年，这也是民主党人最后一次赢得奥马哈市长选举。

en.s: Afriqiyah Airways Flight 771 was a scheduled international Afriqiyah Airways passenger flight from Johannesburg, South Africa to Tripoli, Libya. On 12 May 2010 at about 06:01 (04:01 UTC) while on approach to Tripoli International Airport, the aircraft operating the flight, an Airbus A330, crashed about 1,200 metres (3,900 ft; 1,300 yd) short of the runway. Of the 104 passengers and crew on board, 103 were killed.

zh.s: 泛非航空771号班机是一趟从南非约翰内斯堡飞往利比亚的黎波里的定期国际客运航班。2010年5月12日约06:01（协调世界时04:01），飞机在接近的黎波里国际机场时坠毁，地点距跑道约1,200米（3,900英尺；1,300码）。机上104名乘客和机组人员中，103人遇难。

en.s: The 2010 UEFA Europa League final was the final match of the 2009–10 UEFA Europa League, the first season of the revamped European football competition formerly known as the UEFA Cup. Played at the Volksparkstadion in Hamburg, Germany, on 12 May 2010, the match was won by Spain's Atlético Madrid, who, after extra time, beat England's Fulham 2–1.

zh.s: 2010年欧洲联赛决赛是2009—10赛季欧洲联赛的最后一场比赛，也是这项从欧洲联盟杯改制后的首个赛季的决赛。比赛于2010年5月12日在德国汉堡的人民公园球场举行。西班牙马德里竞技在加时赛后以2比1击败英格兰富勒姆。

en.s: The 2011–12 DFB-Pokal, the 62nd season of Germany's premier football cup competition, came to a close on 12 May 2012 when Borussia Dortmund played against Bayern Munich at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. Borussia Dortmund won 5–2, their third DFB-Pokal triumph and the completion of their first Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal double.

zh.s: 2011—12赛季德国杯是德国顶级足球杯赛的第62个赛季，于2012年5月12日在柏林奥林匹克体育场落下帷幕。多特蒙德以5比2击败拜仁慕尼黑，第三次夺得德国杯冠军，并首次实现德甲联赛和德国杯双冠王。

en.s: Border Wars was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Ring of Honor (ROH) that took place on May 12, 2012, at the Ted Reeve Arena in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

zh.s: 《边境之战》是荣誉之戒摔角联盟制作的一场职业摔角付费赛事，于2012年5月12日在加拿大安大略省多伦多的泰德·里夫竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2012 Austin mayoral election was held on May 12, 2012, to elect the mayor of Austin, Texas. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Lee Leffingwell. Due to a shift in the following 2014 election from mayoral elections from being held every three years to being held every four years in United States midterm election years, this was an election to an abbreviated term.

zh.s: 2012年奥斯汀市长选举于2012年5月12日举行，选出得克萨斯州奥斯汀市长。现任市长李·莱芬威尔成功连任。由于2014年起奥斯汀市长选举的周期从每三年一次改为每四年一次，并安排在美国中期选举年份举行，因此本次选举产生的任期较短。

en.s: The 2012 FA Trophy Final was the 43rd final of the Football Association's cup competition for levels 5–8 of the English football league system. The match was contested by Newport County and York City. York City were beaten finalists in 2009, but it was Newport County's first final and their debut visit to Wembley in their 100-year history.

zh.s: 2012年英格兰足总锦标赛决赛是英格兰足总为英格兰足球联赛体系第5至第8级球队举办的杯赛第43场决赛。对阵双方是纽波特郡和约克城。约克城曾在2009年打入决赛，而纽波特郡队史首次进入决赛，也是球队百年历史上首次造访温布利球场。

en.s: The 2014 Indian general election in Bihar was held in six phases on 10, 17, 24, 30 April, 7 and 12 May 2014.

zh.s: 2014年印度大选中，比哈尔邦的投票分六轮举行，日期分别为4月10日、17日、24日、30日以及5月7日和12日。

en.t: 2014 Indian general election in Uttar Pradesh
en.s: The 2014 Indian general election polls in Uttar Pradesh for 80 Lok Sabha seats was held in six phases on 10, 17, 24, 30 April and 7, 12 May 2014. The total voter strength of Uttar Pradesh was 134,351,297. The main political parties in Uttar Pradesh are Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP), Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), Indian National Congress (INC) and Samajwadi party (SP).

zh.s: 2014年印度大选中，北方邦80个人民院席位的投票分六轮举行，日期分别为4月10日、17日、24日、30日以及5月7日和12日。北方邦共有134,351,297名选民。该邦的主要政党包括印度人民党（BJP）、印度国民大会党（INC）、印度社会党（SP）和印度人民社会党（BSP）。

en.s: A major earthquake occurred in Nepal on 12 May 2015 at 12:50 pm local time (07:05 UTC) with a moment magnitude of 7.3, 18 km (11 mi) southeast of Kodari. The epicenter was on the border of Dolakha and Sindhupalchowk, two districts of Nepal. This earthquake occurred on the same fault as the larger magnitude 7.8 earthquake of 25 April, but further east than the original quake. As such, it is considered to be an aftershock of the 25 April quake. It struck at a depth of 18.5 kilometres (11.5 mi). Shaking was felt in northern parts of India including Bihar, Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal.

zh.s: 2015年5月12日当地时间中午12时50分（协调世界时07时05分），尼泊尔发生一次强烈地震，矩震级为7.3级，震中位于科达里东南18公里（11英里）处。震中在尼泊尔多拉卡县和辛杜帕尔乔克县交界处。这次地震发生在4月25日那场7.8级地震的同一断层上，但位置更偏东，因此被视为4月25日地震的余震。震源深度为18.5公里（11.5英里）。印度北部的比哈尔邦、北方邦和西孟加拉邦均有震感。

en.s: On May 12, 2015, an Amtrak Northeast Regional train from Washington, D.C. bound for New York City derailed and crashed on the Northeast Corridor in the Port Richmond neighborhood of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Of 238 passengers and 5 crew on board, 8 were killed and over 200 injured, 11 critically. The train was traveling at 102 mph (164 km/h) in a 50 mph (80 km/h) zone of curved tracks when it derailed. Some of the passengers had to be extricated from the crashed cars. Many of the passengers and local residents helped first responders during the rescue operation.

zh.s: 2015年5月12日，一列从华盛顿特区开往纽约市的美铁东北地区列车在宾夕法尼亚州费城波特里士满社区的东北走廊线上脱轨并撞毁。车上有238名乘客和5名乘务人员，其中8人死亡、200多人受伤，11人伤势严重。列车在弯道上以每小时102英里（164公里）的速度行驶，而该处限速为每小时50英里（80公里）。部分乘客被困在变形的车厢里，需要救援人员脱困。许多乘客和当地居民也参与协助救援人员。

en.s: The 2015 North Miami mayoral election was held on May 12, 2015. Incumbent Mayor Smith Joseph, who was first elected in a 2014 special election, ran for re-election to a full term. He was originally set to face former City Councilman Jean Marcellus, who had previously run in the 2013 and 2014 elections.

zh.s: 2015年北迈阿密市长选举于2015年5月12日举行。现任市长史密斯·约瑟夫此前在2014年补选中首次当选，这次竞选连任完整任期。他原本将与前市议员让·马塞勒斯对决；马塞勒斯此前曾参加2013年和2014年的选举。

en.s: A special election for Mississippi's 1st congressional district was held on May 12, 2015, to fill the term left by the vacancy created by the death of Alan Nunnelee. Nunnelee, a member of the Republican Party, died on February 6, 2015. According to Mississippi state law, Governor Phil Bryant had to call the special election within 60 days of Nunnelee's death, and had to be held at least 60 days after the call.

zh.t: 2015年密西西比州第一国会选区补选
zh.s: 密西西比州第一国会选区于2015年5月12日举行补选，以填补艾伦·纳恩利去世后留下的任期空缺。共和党籍的纳恩利于2015年2月6日去世。根据密西西比州法律，州长菲尔·布莱恩特须在纳恩利去世后60天内宣布举行补选，投票日期则须安排在宣布后至少60天。

en.t: 2015 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: There were three special elections to the United States House of Representatives in 2015 during the 115th United States Congress. All of the elections were won by the party previously holding the seat. Therefore, there were no net changes in party. Elections are sorted by date and district.

en.s: The WannaCry ransomware attack was a worldwide cyberattack in May 2017 by the WannaCry ransomware cryptoworm, which targeted computers running the Microsoft Windows operating system by encrypting data and demanding ransom payments in the form of bitcoin cryptocurrency. It was propagated using EternalBlue, an exploit developed by the United States National Security Agency (NSA) for Microsoft Windows systems. EternalBlue was stolen and leaked by a group called The Shadow Brokers (TSB) a month prior to the attack. While Microsoft had released patches previously to close the exploit, much of WannaCry's spread was from organizations that had not applied these patches, or were using older Windows systems that were past their end of life. These patches were critical to organizations' cyber security but many were not implemented due to general ignorance of their importance. The attack began at 07:45 UTC on 12 May 2017 and was halted a few hours later at 15:03 UTC by the registration of a kill switch discovered by Marcus Hutchins.

zh.s: 2017年5月，WannaCry勒索软件蠕虫在全球发动网络攻击，目标是运行微软Windows操作系统的电脑。它会加密数据并索要比特币赎金。攻击利用了美国国家安全局（NSA）为Windows系统开发的EternalBlue漏洞。一个名为“影子经纪人”的团体在攻击发生前一个月窃取并泄露了EternalBlue。微软此前已发布补丁修复该漏洞，但许多机构未安装补丁，或仍在使用已停止维护的旧版Windows系统，导致WannaCry大范围传播。尽管这些补丁对机构网络安全至关重要，许多机构仍因普遍不了解其重要性而没有安装。攻击于2017年5月12日协调世界时07:45开始，数小时后在马库斯·哈钦斯发现的“终止开关”域名被注册后，于15:03停止。

zh.s: 2017年霍姆斯东部攻势是叙利亚内战期间叙利亚阿拉伯军及其盟友在霍姆斯省东部开展的一次军事行动，对手是伊拉克和黎凡特伊斯兰国部队。

en.s: The 2017–2020 Qatif unrest was a phase of conflict in the Qatif region of Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia, between Saudi security forces and the local Shia community, that arose sporadically starting in 1979, including a series of protests and repression during the 2011–12 Saudi Arabian protests. This phase of the conflict began after an incident on 12 May 2017, when a child and a Pakistani man were shot and killed.

zh.s: 2017—2020年盖提夫骚乱是沙特阿拉伯东部省盖提夫地区的一段冲突时期，交战双方是沙特安全部队和当地什叶派社群。当地冲突自1979年以来零星发生，包括2011—12年沙特阿拉伯抗议期间的一系列抗议和镇压。新一阶段的冲突始于2017年5月12日一起事件之后，当时一名儿童和一名巴基斯坦男子遭枪击身亡。

en.s: On 12 May 2018, a 20-year-old Chechnya-born French citizen, armed with a knife, killed one pedestrian and injured four others near the Palais Garnier opera house in Paris, France, before being fatally shot by police. The stabbings were in the area of Rue Saint-Augustin and Passage Choiseul. French President Emmanuel Macron said France had "paid once again the price of blood but will not cede an inch to the enemies of freedom."

zh.s: 2018年5月12日，一名20岁、出生于车臣的法国公民持刀在法国巴黎加尼叶歌剧院附近袭击路人，造成一人死亡、四人受伤，随后被警方开枪击毙。袭击发生在圣奥古斯丁街和舒瓦瑟尔通道一带。法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙表示，法国“再次付出了鲜血的代价，但不会向自由的敌人让出一寸土地”。

en.s: UFC 224: Nunes vs. Pennington was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that was held on May 12, 2018, at the Jeunesse Arena in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

zh.s: UFC 224：努涅斯对阵彭宁顿是一场由终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）主办的综合格斗赛事，于2018年5月12日在巴西里约热内卢的青年竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2018 Karnataka Legislative Assembly election was held on 12 May 2018 in 222 constituencies to the Karnataka Legislative Assembly. The election was postponed in Jayanagar and Rajarajeshwari Nagar, following the death of the MLA B. N. Vijaya Kumar and a voter fraud scandal respectively, until 28 May. The election saw a voter turnout of 72.13 per cent, the highest in Karnataka for several decades.

zh.t: 2018年卡纳塔克邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 2018年5月12日，卡纳塔克邦立法议会选举在222个选区举行。由于议员B·N·维贾亚·库马尔去世，以及发生选民舞弊丑闻，贾亚纳加尔和拉贾拉杰什瓦里纳加尔选区的投票推迟至5月28日。此次选举的投票率为72.13%，是卡纳塔克邦数十年来最高的一次。

en.s: The 2018 National League play-off final, known as the Vanarama National League Promotion Final for sponsorship reasons, was a football match played at Wembley Stadium in London on 12 May 2018 to decide the second team to be promoted from the National League to EFL League Two for the 2018–19 season. The culmination of the 2018 National League play-offs saw Tranmere Rovers beat Boreham Wood to earn promotion alongside the National League champions Macclesfield Town.

zh.t: 2018年英格兰全国联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2018年英格兰全国联赛升级附加赛决赛因赞助原因又称Vanarama全国联赛升级决赛，于2018年5月12日在伦敦温布利球场举行，决定第二支从全国联赛升入2018—19赛季英格兰足球乙级联赛的球队。特兰米尔流浪者击败博勒姆伍德，获得升级资格，与联赛冠军麦克尔斯菲尔德镇一同升入乙级联赛。

en.s: The 2018 Greek Cup final was the 74th final of the Greek Cup. It took place on 12 May 2018 at the Olympic Stadium. The contesting teams were AEK Athens and PAOK for a second time in row. It was AEK Athens' twenty third Greek Cup final and third consecutive, of their 94-year history and PAOK's nineteenth Greek Cup final and second consecutive, in their 92 years of existence.

zh.s: 2018年希腊杯决赛是该赛事的第74场决赛，于2018年5月12日在奥林匹克体育场举行。参赛双方是雅典AEK和PAOK，这是两队连续第二年在决赛中相遇。雅典AEK队史第23次进入希腊杯决赛，也是94年队史中连续第三年进入决赛；PAOK则是队史第19次进入决赛，也是92年队史中连续第二年进入决赛。

en.s: The 2018 European Rugby Champions Cup Final was the final match in the 2017–18 European Rugby Champions Cup, and the twenty-third European club rugby final in general. Irish club Leinster defeated French club Racing 92 in the final played in Bilbao, Spain — the first time it was contested outside one of the Six Nations countries.

zh.s: 2018年欧洲橄榄球冠军杯决赛是2017—18赛季欧洲橄榄球冠军杯的最后一场比赛，也是欧洲俱乐部橄榄球历史上的第23场决赛。爱尔兰俱乐部伦斯特在决赛中击败法国俱乐部92竞技。比赛在西班牙毕尔巴鄂举行，是赛事首次在六国锦标赛参赛国以外举办。

zh.s: 2019年5月12日，印度哈里亚纳邦举行大选投票，选出第17届人民院议员。

en.s: The 2019 Indian general election were held on 12 May 2019. Along with all other states, results in Delhi were declared on 23 May 2019 to constitute the 17th Lok Sabha.Bharatiya Janata Party won all 7 seats, for a second consecutive term.

zh.s: 2019年印度大选中，德里于5月12日举行投票，结果于5月23日公布，以选出第17届人民院议员。印度人民党赢得全部7个席位，连续第二次包揽德里席位。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Lithuania on 12 May 2019, with a second round held on 26 May 2019. Due to a constitutional limit of two terms in office, incumbent president Dalia Grybauskaitė was unable to run, having won the 2009 and 2014 elections. As no candidate obtained 50% of the vote in the first round, a second round was held between the top two candidates, Ingrida Šimonytė and Gitanas Nausėda.

zh.s: 立陶宛于2019年5月12日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于5月26日举行。由于宪法规定总统最多连任一届，时任总统达利娅·格里包斯凯特因已在2009年和2014年当选，不能再次参选。首轮没有候选人获得50%的选票，因此得票最高的英格丽达·希莫尼特和吉塔纳斯·瑙塞达进入第二轮。

en.s: The 2020 Nebraska Democratic presidential primary took place on May 12, 2020, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election. The Nebraska primary was a semi-closed primary and awarded 33 delegates to the 2020 Democratic National Convention, of which 29 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the primary, and was the only contest on that date.

zh.t: 2020年内布拉斯加州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2020年内布拉斯加州民主党总统初选于2020年5月12日举行，是民主党2020年总统候选人提名初选的一部分。该州采用半封闭式初选，并分配33名代表参加2020年民主党全国代表大会，其中29名是按初选结果分配的承诺代表。这是当天唯一举行的初选。

en.s: A special election was held to fill the remainder of the term in the United States House of Representatives for Wisconsin's 7th congressional district in the 116th United States Congress. Sean Duffy, the incumbent representative, announced his resignation effective September 23, 2019, as his wife was about to give birth to a child with a heart condition.

zh.t: 2020年威斯康星州第七国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 这场特别选举用于填补美国第116届国会期间威斯康星州第七国会选区的众议员席位空缺。原任众议员肖恩·达菲宣布辞职，自2019年9月23日起生效；特别选举于2020年5月12日举行。

en.s: A special election to the United States House of Representatives for California's 25th congressional district was held March 3, 2020, the same day as the California presidential primaries. As no candidate received a majority, a runoff took place on May 12, 2020, between the top two finishers Christy Smith and Mike Garcia. Garcia's win was the first time Republicans flipped a Democratic-held House seat in California since 1998.

zh.t: 2020年加利福尼亚州第25国会选区补选
zh.s: 2020年3月3日举行加利福尼亚州总统初选的同一天，该州第25国会选区也举行了美国众议院补选，以完成第116届国会剩余任期。由于没有候选人获得多数票，克里斯蒂·史密斯和迈克·加西亚这两名得票最高的候选人于2020年5月12日进入第二轮。加西亚获胜，这是自1998年以来共和党人首次在加州赢得原由民主党控制的众议院席位。

en.s: The 2021 Russian Cup final was the 29th Russian Cup Final, the final match of the 2020–21 Russian Cup. It was played at Nizhny Novgorod Stadium in Nizhny Novgorod, Russia, on 12 May 2021, contested by FC Lokomotiv Moscow and Krylia Sovetov Samara. Lokomotiv won the match 3–1. It was the second occasion in a row in which a second-tier FNL club qualified for the final.

zh.s: 2021年俄罗斯杯决赛是第29届俄罗斯杯决赛，也是2020—21赛季俄罗斯杯的最后一场比赛。决赛于2021年5月12日在俄罗斯下诺夫哥罗德的下诺夫哥罗德体育场举行，对阵双方是莫斯科火车头和萨马拉苏维埃之翼。火车头以3比1获胜。这也是连续第二年有一支俄罗斯足球全国联赛（次级联赛）球队进入决赛。

en.s: The military forces of Armenia and Azerbaijan have been engaged in a border conflict since 12 May 2021, when Azerbaijani soldiers crossed several kilometers into Armenia in the provinces of Syunik and Gegharkunik. Despite international calls for withdrawal from the European Parliament, France, Iran, and the United States, Azerbaijan has maintained its presence on Armenian soil, occupying at least 215 square kilometers (83 sq mi) of internationally recognized Armenian territory.

zh.t: 亚美尼亚—阿塞拜疆边境危机（2021 年至今）
zh.s: 自 2021 年 5 月 12 日起，亚美尼亚和阿塞拜疆军队持续发生边境冲突。当日，阿塞拜疆士兵进入亚美尼亚境内数公里，地点在休尼克省和格加尔库尼克省。尽管欧洲议会、法国、伊朗和美国呼吁撤军，阿塞拜疆仍驻留在亚美尼亚领土上，占据至少 215 平方公里（83 平方英里）的国际公认亚美尼亚领土。

en.s: The battle of Rubizhne was a major urban military battle in the eastern theatre of the Russo-Ukrainian war. The battle took place between 17 March and 12 May 2022. The city came under Russian control on 12 May.

zh.s: 鲁比日内战役是俄乌战争东部战场的一场大型城市战役，发生于2022年3月17日至5月12日。5月12日，俄军控制了该市。

en.s: Bellator 296: Mousasi vs. Edwards (also known as Bellator Paris) was a mixed martial arts event produced by Bellator MMA that took place on May 12, 2023, at Accor Arena in Paris, France.

zh.s: Bellator 296：穆萨西对阵爱德华兹，又称Bellator巴黎站，是一场由Bellator综合格斗联盟举办的赛事，于2023年5月12日在法国巴黎雅高竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2023 King Cup final was the 48th final of the King Cup, Saudi Arabia's main football knock-out competition since its inception in 1957. The final was played at the King Abdullah Sports City in Jeddah, on 12 May 2023. The match was contested by Al-Hilal and Al-Wehda. It was Al-Hilal's 18th King Cup final and Al-Wehda's 8th.

zh.s: 2023年沙特国王杯决赛是第48届国王杯决赛。国王杯自1957年创办以来一直是沙特阿拉伯主要的足球淘汰赛。决赛于2023年5月12日在吉达阿卜杜拉国王体育城举行，参赛双方是利雅得新月和麦加统一。这是利雅得新月第18次参加国王杯决赛，麦加统一则是第8次。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Lithuania on 12 May 2024, alongside a referendum on allowing multiple citizenships. Incumbent President Gitanas Nausėda won re-election to a second term. When candidate registrations closed before the election, the Lithuanian Central Election Commission had confirmed fifteen viable registrations; of those, twelve proceeded to collect signatures from the minimum 20,000 voters. Four of those contenders were later repudiated or dropped out, leaving eight on the ballot.

zh.s: 立陶宛于2024年5月12日举行总统选举，并就是否允许多重国籍举行公投。现任总统吉塔纳斯·瑙塞达成功连任，开始第二个任期。候选人登记截止时，立陶宛中央选举委员会确认15人符合参选条件；其中12人随后开始收集至少20,000名选民的签名。后来有4名候选人退出或被取消资格，最终有8人列入选票。

en.s: The 2024 ABSA Cup final was an association football match played at Heroes Stadium in Lusaka, Zambia on May 12, 2024. The match was played between Red Arrows and Kabwe Warriors at Heroes Stadium. The event was organized by the Football Association of Zambia (FAZ) and represented the 18th final of the annual knock-out competition in Zambian football.The tournament involved six teams from the Super League and the top two teams from the National Division One, following the conclusion of match day 17 of the 2023–24 season.

zh.s: 2024年阿布萨杯决赛是2024年5月12日在赞比亚卢萨卡英雄体育场举行的一场足球比赛。参赛双方是红箭队和卡布韦勇士队。比赛由赞比亚足球协会主办，是赞比亚年度淘汰制杯赛的第18场决赛。该赛事共有8支球队参赛，包括超级联赛6支球队和全国甲级联赛前两名球队；此前已完成2023—24赛季第17轮比赛。

en.s: The 2024 Women's FA Cup final was the 54th final of the Women's FA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was the 30th to be played directly under the auspices of The Football Association and was named the Adobe Women's FA Cup final due to sponsorship reasons. The final was contested between would-be first time winners Manchester United and Tottenham Hotspur, on 12 May 2024 at Wembley Stadium in London.

zh.s: 2024年英格兰女子足总杯决赛是英格兰女子足球主要杯赛的第54场决赛。由于赞助原因，赛事称为Adobe女子足总杯决赛。这是英格兰足球总会直接主办的第30场决赛。决赛于2024年5月12日在伦敦温布利球场举行，参赛双方曼彻斯特联和托特纳姆热刺此前都未曾夺冠。

en.s: A regional election was held in Catalonia on 12 May 2024 to elect the 15th Parliament of the autonomous community. All 135 seats in the Parliament were up for election. The coalition government formed by Republican Left of Catalonia (ERC) and Together for Catalonia (Junts) had broken up in October 2022, with president Pere Aragonès having to rely in the support of the Socialists' Party of Catalonia (PSC) and In Common We Can (ECP) for stability.

zh.s: 加泰罗尼亚于2024年5月12日举行自治区议会选举，选出该自治区第15届议会。议会全部135个席位都进行改选。加泰罗尼亚共和左翼党和“为了加泰罗尼亚”组成的联合政府于2022年10月解散，时任自治区主席佩雷·阿拉贡内斯不得不依靠加泰罗尼亚社会党和“我们共同”联盟的支持维持政府稳定。

en.s: The 2024 Armenian Cup final was the 33rd Armenian Cup Final, and the final match of the 2023–24 Armenian Cup. It was played at the Republican Stadium in Yerevan, Armenia, on 12 May 2024, and contested by Ararat-Armenia and Urartu, with Ararat-Armenia winning their first title.

zh.s: 2024年亚美尼亚杯决赛是第33届亚美尼亚杯决赛，也是2023—24赛季赛事的最后一场比赛。决赛于2024年5月12日在亚美尼亚埃里温共和国体育场举行，对阵双方是阿拉拉特-亚美尼亚和乌拉尔图。阿拉拉特-亚美尼亚首次夺冠。
